channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Former Bama star quarterback Tua Tagovailoa released by Dolphins, appears to be heading to the Falcons
item.description: The Miami Dolphins are moving on from former Alabama star quarterback Tua Tagovailoa, who will apparently be heading to the Atlanta Falcons.

item.title: Three injured in Montgomery County boat crash
item.description: The single-vessel crash happened around 7:20 p.m. Saturday on the Alabama River near the Northern Boulevard in Montgomery County.

item.title: Troy falls to James Madison 69-52 in Sun Belt Women’s Basketball Championship Game
item.description: The Trojans were seeking a fourth Sun Belt women's basketball title.

item.title: Armory Learning Arts Center to open new exhibit
item.description: A new exhibit is about to open at the Armory Learning Arts Center in downtown Montgomery.

item.title: Montgomery Public Schools preparing for Special Olympics
item.description: Special Olympics competitions involving students in Montgomery Public Schools are about to take place.

item.title: The Spring Storm Season Is Underway
item.description: Strong to severe storms possible tonight and again around the middle of the week.

item.title: Selma leaders speak about safety concerns following shootings during Bridge Crossing Jubilee weekend
item.description: Two shootings that injured eight people during the Bridge Crossing Jubilee weekend in Selma have raised concerns and sparked conversations about safety at the annual event, which draws thousands of people.

item.title: Testimony begins in Ibraheem Yazeed capital murder trial
item.description: Testimony is now underway in the capital murder trial of Ibraheem Yazeed, the Montgomery man charged with kidnapping and killing 19-year-old Aniah Blanchard in 2019.

item.title: Alabama State falls to Alcorn State 77-65 in SWAC Basketball Tournament
item.description: Alabama State has fallen to Alcorn State 77-65 in the opening round of the SWAC Basketball Tournament.

item.title: Troy repeats as Sun Belt champions with 77-61 victory over Georgia Southern
item.description: Troy has won the Sun Belt men's basketball championship and will be making its second straight trip to the NCAA tournament.
